purpose: Trial of the layered character look (head from the existing art, shared bodies, outfits drawn once per body type). Not wired into the game.

cells: regular body (강재, 승준, 민재, 재민, 호현)
outputs.outfit: mustard cable-knit sweater with a white collar, brown corduroy wide trousers, brown loafers
outputs.prompt: Two front-facing chibi body templates on magenta in the reference sheet's style and pose, slim and regular, each with a blank bald mannequin head (replaced in compositing), wearing the same mustard knit sweater, brown corduroy trousers and loafers.
4x2 sheet of the seven friends' faces from the reference, completely bald (forehead, skull and both ears visible), same size and position per cell, plus a blank mannequin head; magenta background.
4x2 sheet of the reference sheet's eight hairstyles on one blank mannequin head, all hair in the royal-blue dye key; magenta background.

compose: scripts/outfit-layers/trial-compose.py: heads cut just under the chin from akatsuki-atlas.png (hair keyed blue kept below the chin, old collar removed), body scaled to each friend's original height and torso width, hair dyed and skin toned by mask.
preview: _originals/outfit-layers/trial-sheet.webp (row 1 original, row 2 same heads on the shared knit body, row 3 skin tones and hair colours)
compose_layers: scripts/outfit-layers/trial-layers.py: body (mannequin head removed) -> bald face base -> hairstyle (mannequin skin and jaw line removed, scaled x1.16 and raised to fit the face bases) -> hair dye and skin tone by mask.
preview_layers: _originals/outfit-layers/layers-sheet.webp (row 1 own hairstyles, row 2 swapped hairstyles and colours, row 3 skin tones)
v2: Faces are the friends' own heads with only the hair edited away; hairstyles are the original hair pixels (blue dye key) lifted from akatsuki-atlas.png, moved between faces by eye position. scripts/outfit-layers/trial-layers-v2.py; preview _originals/outfit-layers/layers-v2-sheet.webp (row 1 original, row 2 rebuilt from layers, row 3 swapped hairstyles and colours, row 4 skin tones). The v1 face-bases/hairstyles sheets are superseded.
